description: LD-0113 backup pass planner (spec 2026-11-06-backup-from-source §4.2 rules 9-11): new, changed (size or mtime), unchanged, gone (stays in the backup), unique moves (same size, mtime and case-folded name, unique both ways), the per-pass budget (a prefix; the first upload always fits), parent folders parents-first, removed elsewhere (stays deleted until it changes), folder presence, key normalisation, and rebuilding records from the remote tree (uploaded after the last change by the device clock's measured offset and margin, or the one-sided 10-minute floor when no offset is known: LD-0123), and why a backup stops with its words (spec Amendments 12, 12a, 12b and 12c, LD-0121): the first pass's baseline and the pass gate when the notices could not be read; and since Amendment 12d the 10-minute overlap a pass reads notices with, the acknowledged notice ids that keep the overlap from counting a notice twice, and the `since` a client fetches from.
